title: Amiga Screens: A Primer
summary: A technical article exploring the display and screen system of Commodore Amiga computers, likely covering the custom chipset (Denise, Paula, Agnus), video modes like HAM and ECS/AGA, and how the Workbench interface was rendered.
problem_solved: Explains the technical workings of Amiga's innovative graphics system for retro computing enthusiasts
why_valuable: Preserves and documents historical computing knowledge about Amiga's advanced (for its time) display architecture
